objective.statement: Add a text label next to the theme picker that shows which theme is active.

complexity.rationale: One presentational element in one existing component, reading existing store state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A label next to the theme select shows the active theme's name as text (e.g. "Default", "Ocean").
The label updates when the theme changes.
The label is visible at all screen sizes, with no responsive hiding.

in.statement: ThemePicker component: render the active theme name beside the select.

out.statement: Icons, breakpoint-based hiding, new dependencies, store or theme option changes.

provenance.source: Card: New Feature - Add a theme label
Owner answer label_content: theme name as text
Owner answer mobile_visibility: always visible on all screen sizes

capabilityOwners.owner: React component (derived from store value, no new state)
capabilityOwners.rationale: Label is derived render output of the existing theme value.
Theme already lives there; read only.

unit.rationale: No isolated logic beyond a lookup.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour added; the full suite is still run as regression verification.

e2e.rationale: ThemePicker is not mounted in a routed flow worth a new e2e; component test covers it.

increments.behavior: ThemePicker shows the active theme name as text next to the select and updates on change.
increments.doneWhen: Component tests for the label pass and the full suite is green.

tests.description: ThemePicker renders the active theme name label and updates it on change.
